def rescale_to_unit(values: List[float]) -> List[float]:
    """
    Rescale a list of floats so that the minimum becomes 0.0 and
    the maximum becomes 1.0, with all other values proportionally scaled.
    """
    if not values:
        return []

    mi = min(values(values)
    ma = max(values)

    # Guard against division by zero when all elements are the same
    if ma == mi:
        return [0.0 for _ in values]

    k = 1.0 / (ma - mi)
    return [(x - mi) * k for x in values]
